tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: App background: warm ledger-paper cream in light, deep green-black in dark. Behind all screens.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, inputs and sheets sitting on paper.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: search bar, segmented track, skeleton blocks, installment-table header.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, chips and segmented controls. 3:1 or better on paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and helper text on paper, surface and surface-sunken. Never lighter than this.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Ledger green. Primary buttons, links, active tab, brand text on paper and surface.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed state of brand fills and brand-colored text.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Soft brand wash: selected chip, selected segment, hero preview card background. Text on it: ink or brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: coin
tokens.usage: Coin amber. The center + invoice action, logo dot, highlights. Never text on paper.

tokens.name: on-coin
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a coin fill.

tokens.name: coin-soft
tokens.usage: Gentle highlight wash, e.g. the hero monthly-installment strip.

tokens.name: paid
tokens.usage: Money status مدفوع: text and icon on paid-bg, surface and paper. Always with a check icon.

tokens.name: paid-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the مدفوع chip and the saved-confirmation toast.

tokens.name: partial
tokens.usage: Money status جزئي: text and icon on partial-bg. Always with the half-filled circle icon.

tokens.name: partial-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the جزئي chip.

tokens.name: due
tokens.usage: Money status مستحق (due soon): text and icon on due-bg. Always with the clock icon.

tokens.name: due-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the مستحق chip.

tokens.name: overdue
tokens.usage: Money status متأخر: terracotta, not alarm red. Text and icon on overdue-bg. Always with the calendar icon.

tokens.name: overdue-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the متأخر chip and the late worklist row accent.

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: Money status غير معروف: text and icon on unknown-bg. Always with the question icon.

tokens.name: unknown-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the غير معروف chip.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: True system errors only (save failed, no connection, bad input). Text and icon on error-bg and surface.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and inline error text blocks.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on a solid error fill (danger button).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 3:1 or better on paper, surface and every status background.

families.sans: "Notah Latin", "Notah Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen titles on login and empty states.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: App bar titles, section headings, customer name on profile.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles: product name, customer name in a row.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text. 16px is the floor for anything a person must read.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, row names.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, segment and chip labels.

styles.name: helper
styles.usage: Helper text, dates, captions under fields. Muted ink, never lighter.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Status chips and tab labels only. The one place text goes below 15px, always paired with an icon.

styles.name: display-money
styles.usage: The hero number on a screen: the monthly installment in the live preview, the balance on a contract.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control; between label and field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related rows; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between major blocks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on login and empty states.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet and sticky bar clearance.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips inside rows, progress bars, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, banners, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, splash tile, app icon corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, duration chips, search bar, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards and rows. In dark the card edge comes from line, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Toasts, sticky bottom bars, sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-fab
tokens.usage: The raised center + فاتورة action in the tab bar.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for any control.

tokens.name: tap-lg
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, inputs, segments: the default height in the shop.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size (Lucide, 2px stroke).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside status chips and helper lines.

tokens.name: column-max
tokens.usage: Web: the app is one centered phone-width column.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Screen side padding.
